title: Printyx Platform Production Readiness - Supabase Migration & Enterprise Features
description: Comprehensive platform review and production readiness initiative covering: self-hosted Supabase migration completion, authentication/security hardening, business process automation, feature consolidation, and enterprise-grade reliability. This PRD addresses 177 missing database tables, 70+ inline routes needing modularization, 15+ incomplete service implementations, and end-to-end business process gaps from lead inception to delivery.

userStories.resolution: Added validateTenantHeader() function that validates x-tenant-id header against user JWT tenant. Returns 403 for mismatches. Platform admins can access any tenant. Security logging added. 13 unit tests.
